description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalukanda, Weligepola D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620153
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, and property rights. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
